goal: scripts/decision-eval/a14/run.ts reports an invalid gold label as corpus_invalid: <N> where N is the 1-based physical line of that row in the corpus file, counting blank lines, instead of the parsed-row index, so a maintainer can find the bad row when the corpus has blank lines (#204 slice 2a; Review advisory review-1 on task decision-model-core, PR #341 merged at c831cc8). Delegated choice: extract.ts exposes the source line number alongside each parsed row and run.ts uses it; extract.ts keeps reporting invalid_gold_label by row id unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/decision-eval-a14.test.ts, run.ts on a corpus whose file line 1 is blank and line 2 is a row with gold "maybe" exits 1 with stderr containing corpus_invalid: 2 (not corpus_invalid: 1); on a corpus with a valid labelled row on line 1, a blank line 2 and gold "maybe" on line 3, it exits 1 with stderr containing corpus_invalid: 3; in both cases no a14-*.json or a14-*.md file is written to --out; the existing malformed-JSON case still exits 1 with corpus_invalid: 2; and extract.ts on a corpus holding gold "maybe" still exits 1 printing invalid_gold_label: <row id>.
